about.heading: We Are Your Gateway to Global Markets
about.paragraph1: Ommore is a Pakistan-based digital solutions company helping entrepreneurs across Asia and the Middle East register companies, open marketplace accounts, and reach global customers.
about.paragraph2: From US LLC formation to Amazon seller accounts to full digital marketing support, we handle the paperwork and platforms so you can focus on selling.

whyChooseUs.heading: Why Choose Ommore
whyChooseUs.card1Desc: US LLC formation completed within 48 hours of document submission.
whyChooseUs.card2Desc: We handle IRS filings, annual reports, and registered agent requirements across US, UK, and Australia.
whyChooseUs.card3Desc: From Amazon to TikTok Shop, we set up and manage accounts across 7+ marketplaces.
whyChooseUs.card4Desc: From company registration to digital marketing, one team handles your entire business setup.
